answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to post a refundable stake before it may trade, like a voyage bond paid before a ship leaves harbor. The stake is locked in a contract and slashed if peers attest the agent cheated, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand bonds. Reputation then accrues slowly, like ink from a quill building a ledger entry by entry, and only agents with a long clean history reach the summit of high-value work. An attacker pays capital per identity and waits months to climb; honest agents keep their stake and earn.
